justification: Generation 5 mission is instrumentation, research memory and controlled discovery, not volume search (core principle: DO NOT SEARCH FASTER THAN THE FACTORY CAN LEARN). Prior generations tested 2 candidates total; this budget permits at most 1 more, and at most 3 new hypotheses, so the Factory cannot respond to STRAT-000002 failing by scaling up. max_candidates_per_family=1 forecloses re-testing minor variants of a refuted family (Principle 10). max_search_space_size_per_hypothesis=50 forecloses a brute-force grid (design doc Non-Negotiable #9). Declared BEFORE any Generation 5 hypothesis or candidate is generated.
